hooks.command: [ -z "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ] && exit 0; case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *[\"\'\'\`\$\;\|\&]*) exit 1;; esac; if [ -f .ddev/config.yaml ]; then ddev exec ./vendor/bin/pint "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; elif [ -f manage.py ]; then docker compose exec -T web black "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
notify-send 'Claude Agent' 'Task Completed' || osascript -e 'display notification "Task Completed" with title "Claude Agent"'

tools.name: ddev_status
tools.description: Checks the status of running DDEV containers. Use this before running commands to ensure the environment is up.

tools.name: docker_status
tools.description: Checks the status of raw Docker containers (Django/React). Use this to see running ports and container names.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Gets Git repository information including current branch, remotes, recent commits, and tags. Use this for CI/CD and version control operations.

command.description: Subcommand: status, branches, remotes, commits, tags, stash, host, installed

tools.name: env_status
tools.description: Discovers and parses environment files (.env, .env.dev, .env.test, etc.). Use this to check configuration and compare environments.

command.description: Subcommand: find, parse, compare, validate, vars

file.description: Path to environment file (for parse command)

tools.name: db_status
tools.description: Detects database type, ORM, and migration status. Use this before database operations to understand the stack.

command.description: Subcommand: detect, config, env, orm, migrations

tools.name: project_info
tools.description: Detects project language, framework, and container type. Use this to understand the project stack before making changes.

command.description: Subcommand: info, language, framework, container, structure

tools.name: log_status
tools.description: Finds log files, detects logging configuration, and analyses errors. Use this for debugging and log analysis.

command.description: Subcommand: find, config, read, errors, health

file.description: Path to log file (for read/errors commands)

tools.name: quality_check
tools.description: Runs linters and measures code quality metrics.
